title: Two decisions cite merge.py by symbol, not line number
why: At the batch 129 merge (main 8d7d36bd9) the merge tool's prose judge found stale merge.py line cites: decision claims-carry-backing lines 78-84 and 112, and decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job lines 13 and 23. The cited lines no longer hold the cited code. Rule git-cite-by-id: cite ids, not paths or lines.
note: Records only (record-writer). Fix: replace each line-number cite with the merge.py function or constant it means, read on main. Check: the prose judge passes both files at the next merge. Related: step stale-cites-tree-clean. PR #3130 (docs only), lane session_013NEJL2HisVioZfLkeaNQpH, 09:22 CST Nov 13. Findings filed as steps lanes-no-ci-record-claims and stale-cites-read-symbol. Out of scope: claims-carry-backing keeps 29 line cites into lint/ and hooks/.
